correctness.rationale: The determinant sum Vol Z_n=Σ_{i<j<k}|det(u_i,u_j,u_k)| gives μ=π/8 and second moment 2/9 by conditional uniform sphere projection. Triple overlaps of 1 index have zero covariance by isotropy; overlaps of exactly 2 have c=1/6−π²/64. Ordered-pair combinatorics yields the exact variance. Hoeffding first projection vanishes, second equals g(u,v)=1/2 sqrt(1−(u·v)^2)−π/8; third canonical projection variance O(n³), hence negligible after n^-2 scaling. Funk–Hecke eigenvalues are strictly negative -a_m at even degree 2m, multiplicity 4m+1; odd and constant sectors zero. Absolute trace convergence Σ(4m+1)a_m=π/8 and Hilbert–Schmidt tail control justify the weighted centered chi-square limit and support. Independently evaluated beta–Legendre integrals through degree 12 and exact n=3,4,5,10,50 overlap counts, matching the claimed coefficients; finite checks do not establish infinite spectrum on their own.
residual_risks: Finite checks corroborate analytical arguments, not arbitrary real-parameter universality.
